snippet.title: 4PGP  - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing 4PGP , available 5th February!
      Enjoy the excitement of 90's arcade games anywhere and with anyone!

4K Announce Trailer can be found here :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNz2HjgZpPg

Race Together!
Share the excitement with friends and family playing split-screen multiplayer.
Hop in a formula car and race on unique tracks from around the world. With its multiple difficulty settings and accessibility options such as assist mode and gyroscopic controls, 4PGP can be enjoyed by everyone from beginners to experts. 

▼Official Website：
https://www.4pgp.com/en/

--------------
▼ Pre-Order the Digital Version : 
• My Nintendo Store
https://www.nintendo.com/sg/games/detail.html?id=70010000111783

▼ Add to Your Wishlist : 
• Steam®
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649530/4PGP_FOURPLAYER_GRAND_PRIX/

【Product Information】
Title：4PGP 
Release Date: 2026.2.5 (Thu.)
Price:
- Nintendo Switch™2 ：$24.99/€24.99
- Nintendo Switch™：$19.99/€19.99
- Upgrade Pass : $4.99/€4.99
Platform: Nintendo Switch™/Nintendo Switch™ 2/STEAM®（TBD）
Genre: Racing
Players: 1 to 4 players
Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, German, French, Chinese (simplified/traditional), Korean, and Japanese
Copyright: Developed in cooperation with VISION REELLE. Published and distributed by ©3goo K.K.
